1.text: Uwiteka ari ku ngoma,Amahanga ahinze imishitsi,Yicaye ku Bakerubi, isi iranyeganyega.

2.text: Uwiteka muri Siyoni arakomeye,Kandi ari hejuru y'amahanga yose.

3.text: Bashime izina ryawe rikomeye riteye ubwoba,Ni we wera.

4.text: Imbaraga z'umwami zikunda imanza zitabera,Ni wowe ukomeza ibitunganye.Imanza zitabera no gukiranuka,Ni wowe ubikorera mu Bayakobo.

5.text: Mushyire hejuru Uwiteka Imana yacu,Kandi musengere imbere y'intebe y'ibirenge bye,Ni we wera.

6.text: Mose na Aroni bo mu batambyi be,Na Samweli wo mu bambazaga izina rye,Bambazaga Uwiteka akabasubiza.

7.text: Yababwiriraga mu nkingi y'igicu,Bakitondera ibyo yahamije n'amategeko yabategetse.

8.text: Uwiteka Mana yacu, warabasubizaga,Wari Imana ibababarira,Nubwo wabahoraga ibyo bakoraga.

9.text: Mushyire hejuru Uwiteka Imana yacu,Musengere ku musozi we wera,Kuko Uwiteka Imana yacu ari uwera.
